title: buymeamemecoin
tagline: A mobile app uses Coinbase Smart Wallet's Magic Spend to onboard users to the Base ecosystem. It accepts memecoin requests via speech, uses LLM models to find suitable options, and allows direct purchases from Coinbase accounts.
description:
a mobile consumer app, focusing on onboarding users to base ecosystem using coinbase smart wallet's magic spend. it accepts user's desired memecoin as speech, finds suitable options from current memecoin ecosystem data using llm models, and allows users to buy it directly from their coinbase accounts, using coinbase smart wallet's magic spend functionality

the project is not complete, it's supposed to be a mobile consumer app focusing on onboarding users to base ecosystem using coinbase smart wallet's magic spend. it consists of a stupid simple microphone button, users try to express the memecoin they desire to buy such as saying "mid-cap memecoin with no whale holders and in a uptrend". we turn this speech to text using google cloud services. the text is later combined with current data obtained from dexscreener api, and given to chatgpt 4.0 turbo, prompted as onchain quant specialized in memecoins. llm offers memecoins, where users can pick one and buy using magic funds functionality of coinbase smart wallet after connecting to dapp.
